description.en: The division that administers unemployment insurance — the office that asks a claimant to certify each week. In this demo the form's Definition points here (`issuer.url`), the renderer draws this name and the department above the form, and the submitted Response pins this document's `url` and `version` as `displayedIssuer`. Host-relative `parentOrganization`, no logo or contact invented for the demo.
description.es: La división que administra el seguro de desempleo: la oficina que pide al reclamante certificar cada semana.
